Its 3900 oriented Hasse incidences form an acyclic directed graph by exhaustive topological sort, establishing the integral wedge of 710 two-spheres through discrete Morse theory. Exact signed fixed-face trace for every one of 2880 group elements and exact integer/rational irreducible pairing establish the representation. The mod-two rank check is independent corroboration, not a substitute for the integral proof.

value.rationale: A join of two simplex boundaries is a canonical sphere input for recently introduced doubling. The exact integral 710-sphere classification strengthens available general connectivity bounds and gives a torsion-free contrast to full nine-vertex matching-complex computations. All 35 S4×S5 conjugacy class traces, 22 nonzero irreducible types, and vanishing invariant subspace give a natural symmetry refinement not recoverable from Euler characteristic or Betti number. A self-contained exhaustive certificate turns this into a reusable nontrivial finite benchmark.
